subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native subagent completion routing become a public `sessions_spawn` argument plus global and per-agent defaults, with `channel` retained as the compatibility default and no channel fallback in `parent` mode?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish correctness, but they cannot choose the permanent model-facing API, configuration breadth, persisted-state contract, or user-visible failure policy.

options.title: Sponsor the full contract
options.body: Reopen or replace this PR with the per-spawn argument, both config defaults, persisted target, and documented parent-only no-fallback semantics.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn only
options.body: Reopen a narrower implementation that offers caller-selectable routing without adding global and per-agent defaults.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep the implementation closed and continue product design in the canonical feature issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full contract
recommendation.body: Reopen or replace this PR with the per-spawn argument, both config defaults, persisted target, and documented parent-only no-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history connection to the native `sessions_spawn` contract, adjacent orchestration behavior, thread-bound spawning, and SQLite state direction.
